addition.item: First release: a hero slideshow built on UIkit, each slide with an eyebrow, title, content, two buttons, an image and an image for phones. Slides can come from dynamic content such as articles.
The eyebrow, title, text and buttons come in one after another on every slide: fade up, slide in, blur in, mask reveal or word by word, with delay, stagger and duration.
Ken Burns zoom in, zoom out, pan left, pan right or alternating, per slide too.
Overlay in black, white, the theme's primary or secondary colour or a custom colour, solid, as a gradient from the bottom or the side, or as a vignette.
Height: full screen (minus the header), a ratio or fixed; content in nine positions inside the page container, light or dark text per slide (the header follows).
Autoplay with its own duration per slide; it pauses on hover and focus, when the slideshow is off-screen or the tab is hidden, and with a Pause/Play button.
Show from/until dates per slide; the builder preview shows scheduled slides marked.
Focal point for the image and the phone image; the first image loads first.
The first slide's title can be the page's H1, the others H2.
Arrows, dots and a scroll-down hint for full-screen slideshows.
